subject: Supplier intake: PO mapping, issuance timing, and line-item template request
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Vertex AI Labs <vendor-ops@vertexailabs.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Supplier intake: PO mapping, issuance timing, and line-item template request

Hi Priya / Vertex team,

Thanks for agreeing to start the supplier intake process with us. Before we kick off the formal vendor setup, I wanted to confirm a few procurement details so we can map your invoices cleanly to Redwood POs and avoid payment delays. Can you review the checklist below and reply with any constraints or confirmations by EOD Tuesday?

Quick checklist (high level):
- PO requirement: Does Vertex require a signed PO before work starts, or do you accept invoices against a pending PO number?
- PO number format: Do you require a specific PO number format on invoices (e.g., RED-##### or any vendor-specific prefix)?
- Invoicing cadence: Monthly in arrears, milestone-based, or per-deliverable? Preferred invoice fields (line-level descriptions, unit qty, unit price, tax codes).
- Line-item structure: We generally prefer jagged line items with SOW id, service category, unit type, USD unit rate, and billable period. Please confirm if you can provide invoices in that structure or if you need a different mapping.
- Tax / W-9 / VAT: Any tax docs we should collect up front?
- Insurance: Do you have a COI template to share?

Attachments: Redwood-Vendor-Intake-Form.pdf (a short fields-first intake form) — please complete and return. I also attached a sample line-item mapping we use for services.

Proposed timeline:
- You return intake + docs by Tue 11/24
- Redwood sends initial PO (if required) or confirms PO number generation by Thu 11/26
- First invoice eligible for payment on cycle following PO acceptance (we'll confirm exact payment date once PO terms are set)

If anything above will block your finance or legal teams, flag it now and I can loop in our procurement lead (Laura) and finance (Marcus).

Thanks,

--
Soojin Lee
Procurement Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com

Attachment: Redwood-Vendor-Intake-Form.pdf (fillable), sample-lineitem-mapping.csv
From: Priya Raman <priya.raman@vertexailabs.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Vertex AI Labs <vendor-ops@vertexailabs.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Supplier intake: PO mapping, issuance timing, and line-item template request

Hi Soojin — thanks for the clear checklist. Quick answers below and a couple of clarifying questions.

1) PO requirement: We prefer a PO for engagement value > $10k. For smaller recurring spend we can invoice and have a PO generated retroactively in our AR system. For this engagement the estimated monthly run-rate looks like ~12k so we'll need a PO ahead of work start.

2) PO format: We can accept any PO string in the invoice; our AR team matches on UUID + vendor name. If Redwood can provide RED- prefixed numbers that helps our mapping but it is not mandatory.

3) Invoicing cadence: Monthly in arrears. We will include line-level descriptions, SOW id, unit qty, unit price, and tax amounts. We do not currently include Redwood internal GL codes on our invoices; will that be required?

4) Line-item structure: We can export invoices in a CSV that matches your sample-lineitem-mapping.csv. I attached a sample COI and our standard payment terms.

5) Tax: Attached is our W-9 and COI (Vertex-COI-sample.pdf). No VAT for US entity.

Questions from our side:
- Can Redwood accept invoices that list an internal SOW reference rather than an explicit PO line-item ID?
- Who will be the PO approver and what is the expected approval SLAs (e.g., 2 business days after intake is complete)?

I'll start by filling out the intake form and return by tomorrow. If that timeline won't work we'll propose an alternative.

Regards,

Priya Raman
Head of Finance Operations
Vertex AI Labs
priya.raman@vertexailabs.com

Attachments: Vertex-COI-sample.pdf, Vertex-W9.pdf
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Priya Raman <priya.raman@vertexailabs.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 08:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Supplier intake: PO mapping, issuance timing, and line-item template request

Thanks Priya — this is helpful. A few clarifications from our side and a proposed line-item template we need you to confirm.

Answers to your questions:
- SOW reference: Acceptable — our AP system can match invoices on SOW + vendor name when PO lines are not available. Please ensure SOW id is included as a discrete field on the invoice.
- PO approver: For initial setup the PO approver will be Laura Bennett (Procurement Lead). Our standard SLA is 3 business days from when we receive a completed intake + required docs (W-9/COI). If any legal review or deviance from standard terms is needed that could extend SLAs.

Proposed line-item template (please confirm ability to emit these fields on invoices):
- line_id (vendor supplied)
- sow_id
- service_category (e.g., model-inference, profiling, ops-support)
- description (short free text)
- qty
- unit_of_measure (hrs, instances, tokens)
- unit_price_usd
- currency
- tax_amount_usd
- billing_period_start / billing_period_end

If you can confirm the template, we'll proceed to generate the PO. Next steps / timeline:
- Priya returns completed intake + docs by Tue 11/24 EOD (you mentioned you would)
- Laura reviews and issues PO by Fri 11/27 EOD (3 business days SLA)
- First invoice can be submitted for Nov month-end (if PO issued prior to 11/30)

Internal note: Vivek — if legal wants to intervene for any custom terms we should expect a delay; please weigh in if we should route this to legal now or only if Vertex returns redlines.

Thanks,
--
Soojin
